title: Discontinued — Every Dead Snack, Soda & Cereal, Memorialized
excerpt: The internet’s memorial for discontinued snacks, sodas, cereals, candy and fast food. Browse the archive, play Gone or Still Here, and mourn responsibly.

★ The Snack Memorial ★
